description_expanded: Summary.css-10xdy1o{font-size:var(--chakra-fontSizes-md);color:var(--chakra-colors-primary-600);margin-top:var(--chakra-space-1);}Experience our inviting Inlet Beach vacation rental—a 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse ideal for families or groups. Just minutes from pristine Gulf Coast beaches, this townhome in the Prominence community offers a shared outdoor pool, private patio, and convenient garage parking. Enjoy the comfort of a fully equipped kitchen, and explore the area with the included golf cart and bikes. A 6-seater golf cart is also included during your stay as well as 4 bikes. Feeling Tip Sea is well suited for gathering with family and friends due to its open floor plan. The living room boasts ample seating with the kitchen and dining area nearby. A great feature of the home is the patio off of the living room allowing for an additional gathering area. Additionally, the first floor includes a half bathroom and full size washer and dryer. Prominence is a popular community on 30A! It is home to a gorgeous resort style pool with abundant seating, green space, and community grills. It is famous for it's town center known as The Big Chill, which is home to an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen for sporting events and movie nights as well as boutiques and restaurants! It is also centrally located to the beautiful white sand beaches of 30A (a quick 1/2 mile bike ride or golf cart ride away). TRANSPORTATION - Street legal golf cart (must be 25 to operate with signed waiver) - Bikes are popular on 30A! 6 are included with this property (4 adult, 2 child sized bikes) NEIGHBORHOOD - Community cooking area - Community green space - Huge resort style pool (heated seasonally: 3/1-4/30, 10/1-11/30 and 12/21-12/31 at the discretion of the HOA) - Close proximity to The Big Chill for live entertainment, boutiques and eateries - Close proximity to Rosemary/Alys beach to the east, Seaside to the west BEACH ACCESS - Deer Lake State Park Beach Access: Located approx .7 miles west of Prominence - Gulf Lakes Beach Access: Located approx 1 mile east of Prominence - Santa Clara Beach Access: ADA approved, near Bramble Grove Rd - approx 3.5 miles west of Prominence (Parking, bathrooms, shuttle stop) - More can be found along the stretch of 30A; these are the most convenient to the property SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 7) - PRIMARY BEDROOM: 2nd floor, King bed, private bath with walk-in shower - QUEEN BEDROOM: 2nd floor, Queen bed, shared bath with tub/shower combo - BUNK ROOM: 2nd floor, Twin over Full bunk beds, shared bath with tub/shower combo FEATURES - 3 Bedrooms / 2.5 Bathrooms - Beach Chairs, Towels - Sleeps 7 - Complimentary Wireless Internet - Fully Appointed Kitchen - Full size refrigerator, 5 burner gas range, full size oven - Full size Washer & Dryer - Close To Boutiques and eateries - Community Grills - Community Green with concerts, movies, sporting events, live entertainment Families will certainly enjoy the close proximity to the amazing Prominence community amenities. The 5,000 sq. ft. pool is surrounded by a large pool deck with abundant seating. Prominence is directly across 30A from The Big Chill, where you can enjoy food, shops and entertainment. SECURITY: - This home has a ring doorbell.Notes* A separate golf cart waiver will be sent after booking. Drivers' licenses and proof of insurance is required prior to receiving the golf card lock box code. Note you must be 25 or older with a valid drivers license to operate the cart. Prominence HOA will issue a $500 fine for any underage operators of Golf Carts within the community even if there is an adult present. *Parking is limited to 2 spaces in driveway. The garage is intended to store the golf cart. * The E bike is for owner use only.
